note: Phase C financial document RESEARCH budget. Deliberately SEPARATE from data/pilot/pilot-budget.json, whose defaults.maxFetches:18 is the frozen production crawl budget and is NOT changed by Phase C. This file bounds a one-off live research pass whose only output is an evidence database and a report under data/pilot/. Bounds exist so the pilot proves the financial document pipeline instead of becoming a downloader. Documents are never read: a PDF is fetched, snapshotted with extraction status SKIPPED, and asserted as a document (URL + title + deterministic kind), exactly like a careers unread notice.
